review: 702.141a-1: the decisions declared the token as an attacker unconditionally, contradicting the Propaganda variant; reworded so the token attacks as its requirement demands when able.

702.141a-2: the opponent-turn variant changed two facts (whose turn and a non-empty stack); split it into opponent-turn (empty stack) and stack-not-empty (A's turn, B's Shock on the stack), added Shock to cards and cleared the stale forge_notes.
702.141a-2: added an in-hand variant so the graveyard-only zone of encore is contrasted.

scenarios.title: Encore exiles the card as a cost and makes a hasty token copy that attacks and is sacrificed at the next end step

setup.notes: Fathom Fleet Swordjack is a 4/3 with Encore {5}{R}; its attack trigger deals damage equal to the number of artifacts A controls, which is 0 here. A has exactly six lands.

decisions: A activates encore of Fathom Fleet Swordjack, tapping 6 Mountains and exiling the card from the graveyard as a cost.
Both players pass; the encore ability resolves.
A moves to combat; in the declare attackers step the token attacks B, as its encore requirement demands when able, and the attack trigger resolves for 0 damage.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt.
Both players pass through to the end step; the delayed trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Fathom Fleet Swordjack is in exile (not the graveyard) as soon as encore is activated. A gets one 4/3 token copy with haste that attacks B: B goes to 16 life. At the beginning of the end step the token is sacrificed and A controls no creature.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B controls Grizzly Bears and blocks the token with it.
variants.expected: The token is created with haste and attacks even though a blocker exists; Grizzly Bears takes 4 damage and dies, the token takes 2 damage and survives, B stays at 20 life, and the token is sacrificed at the beginning of the end step.

variants.label: cannot-pay-attack-tax
variants.delta: B controls Propaganda, and A has no untapped mana left to pay its cost.
variants.expected: The token is created with haste, but it does not attack because A cannot pay Propaganda's {2}: B stays at 20 life. The token is still sacrificed at the beginning of the end step.

scenarios.forge_notes: Token copy attack requirement with a tax (Propaganda): confirm the AI/engine does not force payment.

scenarios.title: Encore can be activated only from the graveyard, for its cost, and only at sorcery timing

setup.notes: A has priority with an empty stack. Encore {5}{R} needs six mana.

decisions: A considers activating encore of Fathom Fleet Swordjack from the graveyard.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Encore can be activated: it is A's main phase, the stack is empty and A can pay {5}{R}.

variants.label: combat-step
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Encore cannot be activated: it is not a main phase.

variants.label: opponent-turn
variants.delta: B is the active player in main1; A receives priority with an empty stack after B passes.
variants.expected: Encore cannot be activated: it is not A's turn.

variants.label: stack-not-empty
variants.delta: A receives priority with B's Shock targeting A on the stack (B cast it with a Mountain B controls after A passed in main1).
variants.expected: Encore cannot be activated: the stack is not empty.

variants.label: in-hand
variants.delta: Fathom Fleet Swordjack is in A's hand instead of A's graveyard.
variants.expected: Encore cannot be activated: it functions only while the card is in a graveyard (casting the card for {3}{R} remains possible).

variants.label: short-on-mana
variants.delta: A controls five Mountains instead of six.
variants.expected: Encore cannot be activated: the cost {5}{R} cannot be paid.
